_note: Doctors. 'id' is a permanent key used by services.json, routing.json and booking.json: never change it. To rename a doctor, edit firstName/lastName/displayName, set a new 'slug', and move the old slug into 'previousSlugs' (the old URL then redirects automatically). Then run `npm run tenant` to refresh tenant/dr-sindhu.json. Names are placeholders given by the account owner (these consultants do work at the clinic). Only facts given by the account owner: Dr. Sindhu's 15+ years of experience was provided on 30 Sep 2026 (experienceStatus approved). No invented awards or stats. photo / photoSecondary = image ids in images.json (the doctor's OWN photos only — never stock), or null for an initials avatar.

doctors.summary: Periodontist with over 15 years of experience; leads the clinic and looks after gums, check-ups, cleaning and smile concerns.
bio: Dr. Sindhu is an MDS periodontist with more than 15 years of experience in dentistry, and she leads the clinic on Ashramam Road. Her speciality is the health of the gums and the bone that anchor each tooth — from bleeding or receding gums and deep cleaning to gum surgery and the long-term maintenance that keeps gum disease from returning.

Over the years she has seen how often a healthy mouth begins with healthy gums, so every treatment plan at the clinic starts with a careful gum check. She also sees patients of all ages for routine check-ups, fillings, cleaning and cosmetic care, and coordinates with the clinic's oral surgeon and root canal specialist when a case needs them.

Patients value her calm, unhurried manner: she explains what she finds in plain language, shows you the options and the cost before anything begins, and makes sure you are comfortable at every step. If you are not sure whom to see, book with her first and she will guide you.
focus: Gum disease, bleeding and receding gums
Care planning with the clinic's specialists

doctors.summary: Tooth removal, wisdom teeth, minor oral surgery and the surgical stage of implants.
bio: Dr. Preethi is an MDS oral and maxillofacial surgeon. She removes teeth that cannot be saved, including impacted wisdom teeth, and carries out minor oral surgery and the surgical stage of dental implants.
Before any procedure she walks you through what will happen, how long healing usually takes and what to do at home afterwards.

doctors.summary: Saving natural teeth with root canal treatment, re-treatment and children's pulp therapy.
bio: Dr. Naveen Kumar is an MDS endodontist — a specialist in the soft tissue inside the tooth. He treats infected or badly decayed teeth with root canal treatment so that they can stay in the mouth rather than be removed.
He also re-treats earlier root canals that have become painful again and provides pulp therapy for children's milk teeth.
